card.name: Start of a new section after a sentence
card.fires_on: A split-off first letter, often D, at the start of a new sentence or heading in drug label text, usually where a word like Dose, Directions, Dextrose or Drip begins. It also fires on a few other section starts such as a number or USP.

modes.label: Capital D starting a section
modes.description: The letter D begins a new sentence or heading right after a period, e.g. Dose, Directions, Drip.
modes.example: Therefore, it should not be autoclaved when it is desirable to sterilize the exterior of the vial.<< D>>IRECTIONS FOR USING THE ACT-O-V

modes.label: D inside Dextrose
modes.description: D begins the drug diluent name Dextrose Injection after the word with.
modes.example: Reconstituted Solution Diluted with<< D>>extrose Injection, 5 % Immediately

modes.label: Other section breaks
modes.description: A section number, USP ending or period before a new dosing sentence.
